final_synthesis_label: Structured Transition Plan with Quantified Milestones and Household Guardrails
final_synthesis_description: All three stakeholders accept a phased, evidence-based transition in which the job is maintained while painting skills and income streams are actively developed; the plan must include concrete go/no-go metrics with a defined time horizon, a quantified financial runway, and explicit household-protecting constraints that treat the affected third party's stability as a first-class requirement rather than a background assumption.
remaining_disagreements: Exact quantification of the financial runway and go/no-go metrics has not been jointly agreed upon
The degree of autonomy the primary decision maker retains versus the household veto power of the affected third party remains unresolved
Specific mechanisms to prevent the plan from defaulting to indefinite deferral have not been formally codified
